verdict.rationale: Statsig supports several autonomous background processes — Scheduled Rollouts that gradually deploy features over time (statsig-docs-3, statsig-docs-25), Autotune's multi-armed bandit that automatically shifts traffic toward winning variants (statsig-docs-6, statsig-docs-27, statsig-docs-35), and CLI/Console API integration into CI/CD pipelines to automate gate/experiment management (statsig-docs-31, statsig-docs-11). However these are platform automations, not agentic workflows configured by an 'AI-native' user; the MCP server (statsig-docs-13, statsig-docs-28) is documented as a query/exploration tool for AI assistants rather than a mechanism to set up autonomous background agents. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-triggered or agent-configured autonomous task chains, and any framing of automations as agentic rather than standard rollout/bandit mechanics.
